verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs say developers can get started with Pipedream MCP for free in development mode, and its pricing docs describe a generous free plan with free Connect access while in development. That directly covers prototyping agent tool connections before paying. The free sandbox chat app adds a zero-cost way to try the tools. Missing for 10: specific free-tier limits or quotas (what makes it meaningful), details on what triggers payment when moving to production, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the free experience.
